name: agz-example-command-guard
description: Block dangerous shell commands before the agent runs them, with rules you can switch off or extend.

agzPlugin.name: Command Guard
agzPlugin.description: Block dangerous shell commands before the agent runs them, with rules you can switch off or extend.

description.en: Comma-separated rule ids, for example git-reset-hard,chmod-777. Run /guard-rules to list the ids.
description.tr: Virgülle ayrılmış kural kimlikleri, örneğin git-reset-hard,chmod-777. Kimlikleri görmek için /guard-rules çalıştırın.

description.en: A regular expression, matched ignoring case against the whole command, for example terraform\s+destroy|kubectl\s+delete.
description.tr: Komutun tamamına büyük/küçük harf gözetmeden uygulanan bir düzenli ifade, örneğin terraform\s+destroy|kubectl\s+delete.

description.en: Comma-separated names of the tools that run a shell command in their command argument.
description.tr: Kabuk komutunu command argümanında alan araçların virgülle ayrılmış adları.
